title: Prior-Amortized In-Context Bayesian Inference for Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.24422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical data is ubiquitous in the empirical sciences and is most commonly analyzed with generalized linear mixed-effects models (GLMMs). Bayesian inference for GLMMs yields calibrated uncertainty but requires MCMC; the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) is the gold standard but is slow and must restart from scratch for every new dataset, model and prior. We introduce metabeta, a pretrained neural network for prior-amortized in-context Bayesian inference over GLMMs. Unlike previous neural posterior estimators that fix the prior at training time, metabeta accepts prior families and hyperparameters as inputs at test time, enabling zero-shot generalization. Two set transformers and conditional normalizing flows mirror the posterior's two-level structure (global parameters shared across groups, local parameters per group). The model is trained on millions of realistic simulated datasets spanning continuous, binary, and count outcomes. By default,

translated_title: 面向广义线性混合效应模型的先验摊销上下文贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 分层数据在实证科学中无处不在，通常使用广义线性混合效应模型（GLMM）进行分析。对GLMM进行贝叶斯推断能够提供校准的不确定性量化，但需要MCMC采样；No-U-Turn采样器（NUTS）是金标准，但速度缓慢，且每遇到新的数据集、模型和先验都必须从头开始。我们提出了metabeta，一个用于GLMM先验摊销上下文贝叶斯推断的预训练神经网络。与以往在训练时固定先验的神经后验估计器不同，metabeta在测试时接受先验族和超参数作为输入，从而实现零样本泛化。两个集合变换器与条件归一化流镜像了后验的两级结构（跨组共享的全局参数与每组的局部参数）。该模型在数百万个涵盖连续、二元和计数结果的真实感模拟数据集上进行训练。
tldr: 提出metabeta——一个预训练神经网络，在测试时接受任意先验族和超参数输入，利用集合变换器与条件归一化流对GLMM进行先验摊销的上下文贝叶斯推断，无需MCMC即可零样本泛化并获得校准的后验估计。
en_tdlr: metabeta is a pretrained neural network for prior-amortized in-context Bayesian inference on GLMMs that accepts arbitrary prior families and hyperparameters at test time, using set transformers and conditional normalizing flows to achieve zero-shot generalization with calibrated posteriors without MCMC.
